stops.note: a box, a container, from capere (to take, hold)
a small container, diminutive of capsa
carried into French for a small enclosing case
settled as the English word for a small case, including a soluble medicine casing
stops.meaning: a small case, such as a soluble medicine casing

current_meaning: a small soluble case enclosing a dose of medicine, or a small enclosed container or vessel
